payload.tension: The passage states matthew 12:41–47 identifies a qualified or nonhuman spirit within a scene where it dwells and enters; the wording centers on “An unclean spirit has gone out of a man.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
